_comment: Shuffle SOAR Workflow Export — Phishing Email Triage
_instructions: Import this file into Shuffle via Workflows > Import. Configure API keys for VirusTotal, AbuseIPDB, and TheHive before first run.
name: Phishing_Email_Triage_v1
description: Automated phishing email triage: extract IOCs, enrich via VT/AbuseIPDB, classify risk, create TheHive case

triggers.name: phishing_report_webhook
triggers.description: Receives phishing email report with sender, URLs, and attachment hashes

actions.name: Extract IOCs
actions.description: Parse email body for URLs, IPs, domains, and file hashes

actions.name: VirusTotal URL Check
actions.description: Check each extracted URL against VirusTotal

actions.name: AbuseIPDB Sender Check
actions.description: Query AbuseIPDB for sender IP reputation score

actions.name: VirusTotal Hash Check
actions.description: Check attachment file hashes against VirusTotal

actions.name: Risk Classification
actions.description: Aggregate enrichment results and calculate risk score (LOW/MEDIUM/HIGH)

actions.name: Create TheHive Case
actions.description: Create case with all enrichment data and IOCs as observables

actions.name: Notify SOC
actions.description: Send webhook notification to SOC channel with case summary
